tagline: Your games, as homebrew, in one click
repo_p: Choose the folder that contains <kbd>nxrelink.py</kbd>. It will be remembered.
main_p: Three steps. We take care of the rest.
s1_p: A dump of your own game: a .nup file or a folder with exefs/ and romfs/
s2_p: Directly on the card, or wirelessly to the console
s3_p: Name, icon… otherwise the game's own are used
nro_only_p: Keeps the game files and your saves already on the card
warn: Experimental software · only use backups of games you own.
ports_p: Programs already built on this computer
no_picker: File picker unavailable: paste the path by hand
no_card: No card detected. Insert it, then refresh.
ftp_hint: Start the FTP server on the console: the address is shown on screen. Default port 5000. Every copied file is verified.
sw2t_pw: Password (if one is set in SW2Transfer)
sw2t_hint: Open SW2Transfer on the console (or install its background plugin): the address is shown on screen. Default port 6967. Faster than FTP; every copied file is verified.
none_hint:
The program will be built on this computer, in the out/ folder.
You can install it later from “My ports”.
go_sd: Build and install on the card
all_ready_p: Everything nx2-relink needs is in place.
in_out: The port is in nx2-relink's <kbd>out/</kbd> folder.
installed_ok: The port is installed and every file was verified.
end1: Put the card back in the console (or keep Wi-Fi on).
end2: Start any game while holding <kbd>R</kbd> to open the homebrew menu.
end3: Open the <kbd>nx2-relink</kbd> folder and choose your game.
unsupported: This game uses something nx2-relink does not support yet.
setup_missing: Some requirements are missing (devkitPro, ounce-devkit…). The log says which.
build_failed: The build did not succeed. Your dump was not modified.
tip1: Check that the dump was copied in binary mode (not “ASCII” or “Auto” over FTP).
tip2: If it crashed on the console, attach <kbd>crash.txt</kbd> and <kbd>log.txt</kbd> (folder <kbd>/nx2-relink/<name>/</kbd>) to a GitHub issue.
install_hint: “Install” copies the port to the destination chosen in step 2 ({dest}).
no_ports: No ports yet. Build the first one!
e_game: The chosen game was not found.
e_update: The chosen update was not found.
e_dest: First choose an SD card, an FTP address or SW2Transfer.
e_repo: nxrelink.py was not found in this folder.
miss_p: Downloaded from each project's official site. devkitPro's installer may open: keep the proposed folder and tick “Switch Development”. ounce-devkit adds its repository and signing key to devkitPro's pacman.
auto_failed: Automatic installation did not succeed. The log says why.
